tools.title: Every tool, one canvas
tools.subtitle: Start with a photo, a template or an idea. Everything opens in the same editor.
tools.editorDesc: Crop, adjust light and color, apply filters. Your original is never touched.
tools.bgRemoveDesc: Lift the subject off any background in one click.
tools.aiImageDesc: Describe a scene and get images you can keep editing.
tools.templatesDesc: Posts, stories and flyers sized for every platform.
tools.collageDesc: Drop in photos and let the grid do the layout.

how.title: From photo to post in three moves

steps.uploadDesc: Drop a photo, paste one, or describe what you want to create.
steps.editDesc: Pull sliders, try filters, compare before and after with a single drag.
steps.exportDesc: Download PNG, JPG or WebP sized for the platform you post on.

showcase.title: Same photo. Better light.
showcase.subtitle: Every edit is non-destructive. Slide back to the original whenever you want, and nothing is lost.
showcase.alt: A woman in a sun hat on a beach at sunset, before and after editing

price.a: Yes. PixelForge is free while it's in beta. Every account gets monthly AI credits. Paid plans with more credits and higher export sizes come later, and we'll tell you before anything changes.

coming.q: What's available today, and what's coming?
coming.a: Today you can create an account and build your photo library. The editor, templates and AI tools (background remover, image generator, AI writer) are rolling out over the coming releases.

privacy.a: Only you. Uploads are private by default, location and camera data are stripped from every image, and you can download or delete all of your data from Settings at any time.

cta.title: Your next photo is waiting for better light.
